corrections.text: The headline, summary and the section title 'The advisory half: skills' call the skills 'advisory' in the Herald's own voice. That characterization is InfoQ's ('That guardrail is advice. The agent is asked to obey it.'). Google's blog describes skills as 'Open-source instructions', and the accidental-data-loss-prevention file words its requirement as mandatory for the agent ('you MUST obtain explicit user consent', 'Mandatory Procedure'); neither source calls skills advisory, and the file describes no mechanism that enforces the consent step.

The article attributes the count of 37 skills to InfoQ and also cites plugin release v1.2.0 'dated 30 Oct'. The 37 figure holds for tags 1.0.0 and 1.1.0; by the Herald's own count of skills/*/SKILL.md in the GitHub tree, tag 1.2.0 contains 40 skills (it adds bigquery-observability, bigquery-optimization, bigquery-troubleshooting, cloud-databases-onboarding and gcp-spark-observability, and removes bigquery-sql and google-cloud-auth-verification). The v1.2.0 release timestamp is 2026-10-30T02:52:43Z (UTC), which is October 29 in US time zones.
